setup.title: Set up Schlass
setup.description: Create the administrator account to get started.
setup.passwordHint: Minimum 12 characters, at least one uppercase letter and one digit.

auth.login_description: Enter your credentials to access your account.
auth.change_password_description: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
auth.password_mismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.

self_service.subtitle: You'll stay signed in on this device. All other active sessions will be terminated.

forced.subtitle: Your administrator has asked you to set a new password before continuing.

create.title: Create a new user
create.description: A temporary password will be generated and shown once. The user will be required to change it on first sign-in.
create.password_hint: Minimum 12 characters, at least one uppercase letter and one digit.

role_description.user: Standard account with no admin access.

temp_password_modal.title: Temporary password
temp_password_modal.subtitle: For {{email}}
temp_password_modal.warning: Shown once. Lose it and you'll have to reset.

detail.force_password_change: Must change password on next sign-in
detail.reset_password_success: Password reset. The user will be required to change it on next sign-in.

self.actions_note: Disable and delete are hidden on your own account. To remove yourself, have another administrator do it — or promote a new admin first.

not_found.title: User not found
not_found.body: They may have been deleted by another administrator, or the link is incorrect.

empty_disabled.title: No active sessions
empty_disabled.body: All sessions were terminated when this user was disabled.

confirm.disable_body: The user will no longer be able to sign in, and all of their active sessions will be terminated immediately. You can re-enable them at any time.
confirm.delete_body: This cannot be undone. The user account will be removed and all of their sessions terminated. Audit logs of their past activity will be preserved.
confirm.kill_all_sessions_body: Every device currently signed in as this user will be signed out. The user will need to sign in again on each device.

reset_password.title: Reset password?
reset_password.body: A new temporary password will be generated. They'll be signed out everywhere and forced to change it on next sign-in.

terminate_all.title: Sign out of every device?
terminate_all.body: They'll need to sign in again on each device. Their password is unchanged.

terminate_one.title: Sign out this device?
terminate_one.body: This session will be terminated. Other sessions are unaffected.

account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Signed in as {{email}}
account.totp_placeholder: Protect your account with an authenticator app.
account.signout_description: End your session on this device.

errors.PASSWORD_POLICY_VIOLATION: Password does not meet the security requirements.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please slow down.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Account temporarily locked due to failed login attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_WITH_RETRY_one: Account temporarily locked. Try again in about {{count}} minute.
errors.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_WITH_RETRY_other: Account temporarily locked. Try again in about {{count}} minutes.
errors.INVALID_SESSION: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS: A user with that email already exists.
errors.USER_NOT_FOUND: User not found. They may have been deleted.
errors.CANNOT_OPERATE_ON_SELF: You cannot perform this action on your own account.
errors.LAST_ADMIN_LOCKOUT: This would leave the instance with no administrators. Promote another user first.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to perform this action.
errors.MFA_ENROLLMENT_EXPIRED: Two-factor setup session expired — please sign in again.
errors.MFA_CHALLENGE_EXPIRED: Sign-in session expired — please sign in again.
errors.MFA_CHALLENGE_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts — please sign in again.
errors.MFA_NOT_ENROLLED: This user has not enrolled in two-factor authentication.
errors.MFA_ALREADY_ENROLLED: This account already has two-factor authentication enabled.

enrollment.step1_description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
enrollment.step2_description: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app.
enrollment.step3_description: Store these codes somewhere safe — they're your backup if you lose access.
enrollment.cannot_scan_link: Can't scan? Enter the key manually
enrollment.verify_helper_one: Paste from clipboard supported · {{count}} attempt remaining
enrollment.verify_helper_other: Paste from clipboard supported · {{count}} attempts remaining
enrollment.step3_warning: Save these now — they cannot be recovered.
enrollment.acknowledgement: I've saved these codes somewhere safe.

account.reset_contact_admin: Contact an administrator to reset two-factor authentication.

admin_reset.dialog_description: This clears {{email}}'s authenticator and recovery codes. They will re-enroll on their next sign-in and be signed out of any active sessions.
